title: Reorg, Rebase, and the 2026 Credit Bomb
script_summary:
# ORACLE BRIEF

Foundry just erased two blocks at height 941,880—and that's not noise, that's a power signal. Thirty percent hashrate dominance expressing itself in real time. While you watched price, the mining layer consolidated. Block withholding at that scale changes the conversation.

Meanwhile, the macro credit market is building toward 2026. Largest corporate bond issuance year in history, then cascade defaults. That's not vague—that's a mechanism with a timeline. Bitcoin at 66K is cheap
